name: argent
description: Control, debug and profile iOS simulators, Android emulators, TVs, Mac and Electron apps from Codex

interface.longDescription: Argent gives Codex direct control of iOS simulators, Android emulators and devices, TVs (Apple TV, Android TV, Fire TV), Electron/Chromium apps and native Mac apps. Codex can tap, swipe and type, record and replay e2e tests, diff screenshots against a baseline, read logs and network traffic, and profile with Hermes, React DevTools, Xcode Instruments and Perfetto. The plugin starts the argent command, so install Argent first with npm install -g @swmansion/argent.
defaultPrompt: Run my React Native app on an iOS simulator and take a screenshot.
Profile my app and find what makes it slow.
